# Obelisk

> Unified identity and trust protocol for the VaultSpark ecosystem — one account across every game, tool, and studio surface. Forging now.

## What it is
Obelisk is the unified identity and trust protocol for the VaultSpark ecosystem. Its goal is to provide a single account across every game, tool, and studio surface — built for the AI era. It extends the current Vault Member system into a full identity plane with agent-native capabilities. Vault Members receive first notice when testing opens.

## Current focus
In the forge — core identity protocol design and architecture being established before integration across VaultSpark surfaces.

## Next milestone
Initial integration point: Vault Member portal (providing single-sign-on across the studio ecosystem).
